title: archkeel report — Write an HTML report

story.title: archkeel report — Write an HTML report

chapters.title: Decide and render the same run

steps.title: Enter Report
steps.note: Use report with an output path to request a standalone HTML page.

steps.title: Prepare the project
steps.note: Use the selected contract and the same decision path as validation.

steps.title: Request the report
steps.note: The report request asks the core for HTML and its topology.

steps.title: Prepare the scan
steps.note: Send the scan request and keep the response bytes for delivery.

steps.title: Send the request
steps.note: Pass the request to the Rust child. The process target is not a resolved call.

steps.title: Read the report request
steps.note: The child receives a scan request on standard input. Rust function definitions are indexed, but their calls are not.

steps.title: Dispatch the scan
steps.note: Select the scan handler.

steps.title: Read the HTML flag
steps.note: Decode the scan request, which carries the HTML and topology choices.

steps.title: Choose a scan
steps.note: Use the configuration to select the part to scan.

steps.title: Collect the part
steps.note: Collect the configured source scope before building the report.

steps.title: Supply contract and facts
steps.note: Bind the scanned reply and provenance to the run. Carry through the HTML request.

steps.title: Keep the ruling and its evidence
steps.note: Compute the ruling and the topology before formatting its frame.

steps.title: Render HTML in the frame
steps.note: The report crate formats the same ruling as HTML. Report formatting does not decide rules.

steps.title: Receive the frame
steps.note: The shell receives the frame on standard output. This process response is not a resolved call.

steps.title: Return to the wrapper
steps.note: Return the response bytes for frame validation.

steps.title: Check the response
steps.note: Check the frame protocol and request binding before exposing the result.

steps.title: Return the checked response
steps.note: Return the checked frame and its bytes.

steps.title: Deliver the result
steps.note: Pass the checked frame to file delivery.

steps.title: Write the requested file
steps.note: Ask the report writer to deliver the requested HTML file.

steps.title: Extract the HTML
steps.note: Read HTML from the frame. Attach gap records separately when the page calls for them.

steps.title: Publish the report
steps.note: Write temporary bytes and replace the destination atomically. The page shows the run's verdict and its available evidence.
